action.description: Impartial deadlock resolution: 'approve' waives non-blocking/false-positive findings; 'rework_once' grants one surgical L4 fix round; 'replan' retires the branch to split/re-sequence tasks; 'pivot' retires the branch for a clean rewrite from base; 'park' halts strictly for genuine human tradeoffs, external blockers, or exhausted recoveries.

summary.description: Concise factual synthesis of the technical adjudication grounded in the user's Core need, Design Philosophy, and locked task criteria.

directives.description: Concrete instructions for the Orchestrator, writer, or human decision. Required (non-empty) whenever action is 'rework_once', 'replan', 'pivot', or 'park'.

avoid_dead_ends.description: Failed technical approaches or traps from this attempt that successor slices must not repeat.

waived_findings.description: Specific disputed verifier findings overruled as false positives, out-of-bounds, or non-blocking polish, with technical rationale.

commands_run.description: Deterministic checks and empirical probes executed in the disposable clone during arbitration.
